genius.notes: DAI is a protocol stablecoin generated against collateral through CDP vaults and the LitePSM. The reviewed protocol, Skybase legal-service disclaimer and OCC material do not establish a specific authorized PPSI issuer for DAI; applicability and issuer pathway remain unclear/unknown. The June 18 negative authorization/enforcement review is historical and is not extended to October 1 or to approvals for all issuers. On October 1, the primary Sky site discloses shared DAI/USDS collateral backing through https://financial.skyeco.com/usds/collateral-backing; this is public disclosure evidence, not a statutory monthly attestation, holder-dollar redemption policy, approval or exemption. A current comprehensive authorization review across the cited regulators and applicable state registers is still needed.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of the historical June 18, 2026 review, the listed sources did not establish a DAI PPSI authorization, state-qualified approval, official application, or issuer-announced intent. Protocol CDP generation alone does not adjudicate whether a legal issuer exists or whether the Act applies. The broad statement that no approvals exist for any issuer is not supported by this token-specific review and is withdrawn; this is not an October 1 refresh of all listed regulators.
